No bone is built from this entry any more (see rig_templates/quadruped.py's build_bones); kept here, unused for bone placement, purely as the RADIUS HINT rig_creature.py's force_rigid_to_bone call uses to size the region it forces 100% rigid onto the 'head' bone (both horns + the ears).
